question: Why can Shiva be said to be the fruit of every scripture?
premises: The Svacchanda Tantra states that Shiva is the fruit in every scripture.
What arises from Shiva has Shiva's abode as its fruit.
inference: Because all scriptures originate in Shiva, their ultimate fruit is Shiva.
plain_english: Therefore it is said in the Svacchanda Tantra that in every scripture Shiva is the fruit, because all arise from Shiva and all have Shiva's abode as their fruit.
